intro.title: SAP & CRM Customization
intro.subtitle: SAP Business One and CRM systems hold everything your company needs — but weren't built for a quick, everyday look at what matters.
intro.desc: We build a customization layer on top of your existing SAP Business One and CRM (C4C) data, so your team can consult reports, payments, clients, and projects without digging through menus or exporting spreadsheets. Every implementation starts from Opportunity, our own production-tested platform, and is then tailored to your company's specific workflows, approval rules, and branding.
